episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Tormented by her high school classmates and with nowhere to turn for help, Moon Dong Eun sinks into despair before deciding on a new mission in life.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: With Park Yun Jin's wedding on the way, Dong Eun's revenge rolls out according to plan. Meanwhile, a fateful encounter at a hospital takes place.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: After securing the services of an amateur sleuth, Dong Eun uncovers scandalous secrets that she leverages for the next phase of her scheme.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Already on edge over the past resurfacing, Yun Jin grows more anxious when she learns about her daughter's new homeroom teacher — and of a sudden death.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: While Ha Do Young comes across an intriguing game opponent, Yun Jin realizes her deepest secrets are at stake when she tries to intimidate Dong Eun.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Son Myung Oh's sudden absence causes tension in the friend group. Dong Eun finds her trust in Kang Hyun Nam tested.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Dong Eun shares her traumatic past with Joo Yeo Jung, who has unfinished business of his own. A new plan is put in place for Hyun Nam's daughter.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Do Young meets with Choi Hye Jung to find out more about his wife — and her past. Yun Jun digs into Dong Eun's private life.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Questions arise over Myung Oh, Dong Eun gives Yun Jin a chance to come clean about her past, and the circumstances of Yoon So Hee's death are revealed.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Yun Jin threatens Hyun Nam after discovering her involvement with Dong Eun. Yeo Jung devises a way to get the truth out of Yun Jin.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: Hye Jung finds an incriminating recording on Myung Oh's tablet, and Hyun Nam receives an unwelcome visitor as she prepares to send her daughter abroad.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Dong Eun's end game comes into focus as she sends Jae Joon a troubling package and orchestrates a plan to take down Yun Jin and Lee Sa Ra.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: As Sa Ra and Yun Jin deal with the aftermath of their crumbling reputations, Dong Eun learns the details behind Ye Jung's private struggles.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: Yun Jin and Shin Young Joon panic over Myung Oh. Dong Eun takes care of a lingering problem. Yun Jin's mother schemes to remove a threat.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: Do Young issues an ultimatum. Dong Eun demands a piece of evidence be handed over. Yun Jin attempts to do damage control after old videos appear online.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: As the final pieces of Dong Eun's revenge plot slot into place, she considers what comes next — and what it will mean for Yeo Jung.
